method: Alpamayo-supported sliding-window inference over a continuous 10-second segment
model_input_per_window: 1.6 s ego history plus the latest 4 frames from each of 4 cameras
prediction_per_window: 6.4 s future trajectory plus Chain-of-Causation text
visualization: Camera-calibrated projection on the front-wide image
corridor_note: The blue driving corridor is derived from the model-predicted center trajectory; it is not a separately predicted lane-boundary segmentation.

Change to the left lane after the right turn due to needing to merge into the main through lane and maintain safe spacing with vehicles already traveling on that road, as shown by the trajectory crossing into and then centering within our lane.
Accelerate to proceed through the intersection since the right-turn traffic light is green
Keep distance to the lead vehicle since it is directly ahead in our lane

Change lane to the left due to the upcoming right-lane split into a ramp and a lead vehicle ahead, then continue under the bridge with moderate acceleration because the signal is green and the path is clear.
